visual_action: The video consists of a series of still photographs taken on a military flight line/tarmac on a clear, cold day. Frames 1–2: A military carry team in Army combat uniforms (OCP/multicam) carries a flag-draped transfer case (casket) from what appears to be a military transport aircraft. To the right, a tall man in a dark overcoat renders a hand salute while standing beside a black presidential SUV (Cadillac Escalade/Beast-style vehicle bearing a small military flag pennant); several other officials in dark suits and a military officer in dress uniform also stand at attention or salute. Frames 3–4: A line of approximately seven people — several Air Force officers in dress blue uniforms, at least one Army soldier in OCP, one civilian in a suit, and the same tall man in a dark overcoat at the right end — walk in a procession across the tarmac toward the aircraft ramp. Frames 5: A large group of military personnel in dress uniforms and dark civilian suits stands at attention near a black presidential SUV while an Army carry team in OCP marches past carrying transfer cases. Frames 6–8: The tall man in the dark overcoat stands at the foot of the open cargo ramp of a military transport aircraft alongside a line of Air Force officers in dress blues and one soldier in OCP; all are bowing their heads in a moment of solemn reflection at the transfer cases inside the aircraft. The setting is consistent with a dignified transfer ceremony at Dover Air Force Base.
